name: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Vigyaan Gram Sankul Pariyojana
benefit: - Under the project, rural development work is carried out by forming clusters of villages across various districts of the state. - Based on the natural resources available in the selected villages, various units are established to improve farmers' livelihoods through the application of science and technology.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiaries of the project include selected farmers, entrepreneurs, self-help groups, and general public residing in Uttarakhand.
